{
  "name": "spark-workflow-frontend",
  "description": "React frontend for the SPARK Workflow application.",
  "license": "EUPL-1.2",
  "private": true,
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.30.2",
  "type": "module",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24 <25",
    "pnpm": "10.30.2"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "vite build && tsc",
    "check": "pnpm run \"/^check:.*/\"",
    "check:lint": "pnpm exec eslint --fix && pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level error .",
    "check:test": "pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=agent",
    "check:types": "pnpm run type-check",
    "dev": "vite",
    "dev:port-forwarding": "node src/scripts/validate-port-forwarding-env.js && VITE_DEV_API_MODE=port-forwarding vite --port 3000",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "lint": "pnpm exec eslint",
    "preview:port-forwarding": "node src/scripts/validate-port-forwarding-env.js && VITE_DEV_API_MODE=port-forwarding vite build && VITE_DEV_API_MODE=port-forwarding vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 --strictPort",
    "serve": "vite preview",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage && node src/scripts/print-overall-coverage.js",
    "type-check": "tsc --noEmit --incremental",
    "openapi-ts": "openapi-ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@radix-ui/react-accordion": "^1.2.12",
    "@radix-ui/react-checkbox": "^1.3.3",
    "@radix-ui/react-collapsible": "^1.1.12",
    "@radix-ui/react-dialog": "^1.1.15",
    "@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu": "^2.1.16",
    "@radix-ui/react-label": "^2.1.8",
    "@radix-ui/react-popover": "^1.1.15",
    "@radix-ui/react-radio-group": "^1.3.8",
    "@radix-ui/react-select": "^2.2.6",
    "@radix-ui/react-separator": "^1.1.8",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "^1.2.4",
